title: Product Launch Video and Photos for New Drops | Aidreamcapes
description: Plan your product launch video and photos early: teaser clips, a reveal video and lifestyle shots from one sample photo. Start building your launch set today.
h1: Product Launch Video and Photos, Ready Before Launch Day
lead: For a product launch, video and photos can start from your first sample shot: build teasers, a reveal clip and product page photos, so launch week goes to selling instead of scrambling.
card: Teasers, a reveal clip and product page photos from your first sample shot.
intro: A launch asks for a lot of visuals at once: a teaser to build interest, a reveal for the big day, clean photos for the product page, and something new to post the week after. Arranging a photoshoot for all of that can take as long as getting the product ready.

With Aidreamcapes, you can start from a single photo of a sample, or from a written description if the product isn't in hand yet. Make a short teaser that only hints at the product, a vertical reveal clip, and square photos in a few different settings. Your launch date, price and "new" tag go on later in Canva or CapCut, so a shifted date never means remaking the visuals.

ideas.t: A teaser that hides the full product
ideas.d: A 6-second clip of a texture, a silhouette or a box lid lifting just enough to make people curious.
The product turns into view on a clean background, in 9:16 for Stories, Reels and TikTok.
A square photo of the packaged product on a doorstep or shelf, so early buyers know what will arrive.
Photos of the product where people will use it, for the product page, the launch email and your first feed posts.

plan.d: Pick the photo you'll work from, make the white-background and lifestyle images for the product page, and decide which channels need vertical or square sizes.
Make the teaser and reveal clips, try a couple of different openings, and add the launch date in your editing app.
Do a last check of every file, load your ads and posts, and keep a spare version ready in case one isn't getting attention.

faq.q: Can I make launch content before my product is finished?
faq.a: Yes, as long as you have a photo of a sample or prototype. You can also start a video from a written description alone, though a real photo keeps the result closer to what customers will receive.

faq.q: How do I add my launch date to the video?
faq.a: Put it on after download in CapCut, Canva or your ad tool. That way a date that moves only means editing one text layer, and you avoid the spelling slips AI can make with words and numbers.

faq.q: Will anyone see my unreleased product before I announce it?
faq.a: No. Your uploads and the results stay in your own account and are never made public, so the product stays under wraps until you share it.
